config.randomization_note: lambda scales EVENT-MANAGER terms only. The motion command term applies reset randomization on every training reset regardless of lambda -- root velocity +-0.5 m/s in x and y, +-0.78 rad/s yaw, pelvis +-0.05 m, joints +-0.1 rad -- because dr_scaling never touches the command manager. An arm at lambda=0 is 'no event-manager DR', NOT 'no randomization'.
